cards.enDefinition: a person who buys goods or services from a business

exampleMeaning.en: The customer paid for her new shoes.
exampleMeaning.vi: Khách hàng đã trả tiền cho đôi giày mới.

exampleUsage.en: We provide excellent service to our customers.
exampleUsage.vi: Chúng tôi cung cấp dịch vụ tuyệt vời cho khách hàng.

extras.usage_note: A countable noun: one customer, many customers.

cards.enDefinition: to divide or shorten something with a knife, scissors, or another sharp tool

exampleMeaning.en: She cut the apple into four pieces.
exampleMeaning.vi: Cô ấy cắt quả táo thành bốn miếng.

exampleUsage.en: Be careful not to cut yourself with the knife.
exampleUsage.vi: Hãy cẩn thận để không bị dao cứa vào tay.

extras.usage_note: The past tense and past participle are also cut.

exampleMeaning.en: My dad is cooking dinner tonight.
exampleMeaning.vi: Tối nay bố tôi đang nấu bữa tối.

exampleUsage.en: I went fishing with my dad.
exampleUsage.vi: Tôi đã đi câu cá cùng bố.

extras.usage_note: An informal, everyday word for father.

cards.enDefinition: a series of movements to music, or the act of making these movements

exampleMeaning.en: Everyone danced when the music started.
exampleMeaning.vi: Mọi người đều nhảy múa khi nhạc bắt đầu.

exampleUsage.en: Would you like to dance with me?
exampleUsage.vi: Bạn có muốn nhảy cùng tôi không?

extras.usage_note: As a verb, dance is often followed by with when naming a partner.

cards.enDefinition: a person who dances, especially as a job or skill

exampleMeaning.en: The dancer moved beautifully across the stage.
exampleMeaning.vi: Vũ công di chuyển uyển chuyển trên sân khấu.

exampleUsage.en: She wants to become a professional dancer.
exampleUsage.vi: Cô ấy muốn trở thành một vũ công chuyên nghiệp.

extras.usage_note: A countable noun for a person who dances.

cards.viMeaning: việc nhảy múa; môn khiêu vũ
cards.enDefinition: the activity of moving your body to music

exampleMeaning.en: Dancing is her favorite weekend activity.
exampleMeaning.vi: Nhảy múa là hoạt động cuối tuần yêu thích của cô ấy.

exampleUsage.vi: Chúng tôi đi khiêu vũ sau bữa tối.

extras.usage_note: Usually uncountable when it names the activity.

cards.enDefinition: likely to hurt someone or cause damage

exampleMeaning.en: It is dangerous to swim here because the water is very deep.
exampleMeaning.vi: Bơi ở đây rất nguy hiểm vì nước rất sâu.

exampleUsage.en: This broken bridge is dangerous for children.
exampleUsage.vi: Cây cầu bị hỏng này gây nguy hiểm cho trẻ em.

extras.usage_note: Common patterns are dangerous for someone and dangerous to do something.

exampleMeaning.en: The room was dark because all the lights were off.
exampleMeaning.vi: Căn phòng tối vì tất cả đèn đều đã tắt.

exampleUsage.en: It gets dark early in winter.
exampleUsage.vi: Vào mùa đông, trời tối sớm.

extras.usage_note: Get dark means to become dark.
